\

A report completed as a technical report in in [STAT 454 - Bayesian Statistics](https://catalog.macalester.edu/preview_course_nopop.php?catoid=28&coid=145414) in the spring of 2026. This project uses a Bayesian model (Beta–Geometric framework) to estimate the probability of growing a gold-star cauliflower in Stardew Valley, combining prior beliefs from online sources with empirical data from Twitch streams.

\

This report was created by [Katelyn McClure](https://katelynmcclure.github.io){target="_blank"} and [Max Clifford](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maxwellclifford1/){target="_blank"} for Professor Taylor Okonek.
